name: Secrets
overview: Scripture reveals that certain things remain hidden by God's sovereign design, as He alone knows the secret things, while what He has revealed is entrusted to us for obedience and wisdom. God’s glory includes concealing matters, yet He also honors diligent inquiry and discernment. Believers are cautioned to guard confidences carefully, avoiding the careless disclosure of secrets, while recognizing that God will bring every hidden deed into judgment. In calling upon God, He promises to unveil mighty and hidden truths beyond our understanding.
